english.title: Breach safeguards relating to examination of material - bulk interception warrant - Part 6 Investigatory Powers Act 2016
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) deliberately selected for examination

(A)_[intercepted content]_
(B)_[secondary data]_

obtained under a bulk interception warrant, namely **(..SPECIFY CONTENT OR DATA..), knowing or believing that the selection of that

(C)_[content]_
(D)_[data]_

did not comply with a requirement imposed by section 152 or 153 or the Investigatory Powers Act 2016 in that **(..SPECIFY NON-COMPLIANCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 155 of the Investigatory Powers Act 2016.
english.pointstoprove:
date and Location
selected for examination intercepted content or secondary data obtained under a bulk interception warrant
knowing or believing that the selection of that material did not comply with a requirement imposed by section 152 or 153 of the Investigatory Powers Act
deliberately selected that material in breach of that requirement

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Consent of the Director of Public Prosecutions is required.
(ii) See sections 152 and 153 for details of the safeguards for examination of intercepted content and secondary data obtained under a warrant.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
INDICTMENT: 2 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Note:
In relation to an offence committed before paragraph 24(2) of Schedule 22 to the Sentencing Act 2020 comes into force (01/12/20), the reference to 12 months imprisonment in relation to summary offences, above, is to be read as a reference to 6 months imprisonment.Time limit for prosecutions:
None
